# Synaptro.AI

> Synaptro.AI is an AI-first consulting and development company. We build websites, web applications, and AI systems for startups and growing businesses — including MVPs delivered in 15 days, static business websites live in 7 days, e-commerce stores, education platforms with video/PDF content, AI automation, cloud infrastructure, SEO, and digital marketing. Every project is quoted fixed-price after a free consultation, clients own 100% of the code and all accounts, and every build includes CMS/admin access plus 30 days of post-launch support.

Key facts:
- Flagship offer: MVP development in a fixed 15-day sprint (scoping → design → build → launch)
- Static business websites: live in 5–7 days, hosting $0–5/month, from $600
- Dynamic builds: e-commerce ($2,000–$7,000), education platforms with video lessons and PDF libraries ($2,500–$8,000), custom web apps and portals
- Technology: React + TypeScript + Tailwind frontends; Node.js or Python (FastAPI) backends; PostgreSQL; Vercel/Netlify/Cloudflare for static hosting, AWS/GCP for dynamic
- SEO service covers both Google rankings and AI-assistant visibility (structured data, llms.txt, answer-engine optimization)
- Contact: Abhishekmis0201@gmail.com — replies within 24 hours, free 30-minute consultation
